parameter_origin: Deliberately chosen research scenario levels; not estimated from Agent incidents, commercial claims or actuarial credibility data

plans.display_name: AgentShield Core 基础保障（研究演示）
plans.covered_loss: Subject to A's independent coverage review, verified net extra refund cash outflow caused by a non-intentional error within registered Agent/model/tools/permissions; less traceable recoveries at pre-registered H
exclusions: unverified damages, fines, reputation and opportunity costs
plans.basis: Keep the original A0 engineering deductible of CNY100 and occurrence limit of CNY1000, but apply 80% participation to illustrate merchant co-insurance. Annual CNY100000 is a visibly hypothetical exposure ceiling, not a fitted value.

plans.display_name: AgentShield Plus 增强保障（研究演示）
plans.covered_loss: Same verified primary refund loss as Core, with lower deductible, full post-deductible participation and higher per-event limit
exclusions: unverified damages, fines, reputation and opportunity costs
plans.basis: CNY50 deductible is half of Core; 100% participation and CNY5000 occurrence cap reflect the original research order-value ceiling, NOT an empirically estimated tail. Annual CNY500000 is display-only hypothetical. Incident-response expenses are NOT included in this calculation.

shared_formula: I = min(occurrence_limit, ROUND_HALF_UP((max(L_H - deductible, 0)) * coinsurance), L_H)
annual_aggregate_caveat: Annual cap requires separate chronological aggregation and claim handling; not applied by the A0 single-event code and must not be represented as a calculated yearly paid amount.
